title: Porosity Analysis Results
description: Output contract for save_results_to_json / FESolver.export_results / the Streamlit empirical exporter / the NCR exporter. The envelope (schema_version, format, provenance) is validated strictly so consumers can detect version/contract drift; the science payload is intentionally permissive so adding result fields is not a breaking schema change. The known top-level format identifiers are listed in the `format` enum (#20). An optional `units` block (#131) documents the physical units of the numeric leaves in the payload so downstream consumers reading only the JSON can interpret values without consulting external docs. Every writer emits standard JSON (RFC 8259): never the tokens NaN or Infinity. A value that is not defined is null, only in the fields whose description says when; any other non-finite value makes the writer raise instead.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version (MAJOR.MINOR). Bumped on additive changes; consumers should accept any MINOR within the same MAJOR.

format.description: Output payload identifier. Mirrors the FORMAT_* module constants in porosity_fe_analysis.py.

seed.description: RNG seed for the run (null when unset or ambiguous). Dimensionless.

package_version.description: Deprecated alias of porosity_fe_version; no longer required, to be removed in schema 2.0.

python.description: Deprecated alias of python_version; no longer required, to be removed in schema 2.0.

numpy.description: Deprecated alias of numpy_version; no longer required, to be removed in schema 2.0.

scipy.description: Deprecated alias of scipy_version; no longer required, to be removed in schema 2.0.

generated_utc.description: Deprecated alias of timestamp_utc; no longer required, to be removed in schema 2.0.

git_sha.description: Deprecated alias of git_commit; no longer required, to be removed in schema 2.0.

delta_T_K.description: Temperature change from the stress-free state (K) of a thermal or combined FE solve (FESolver.solve(delta_T=...)); written only for those solves. Added in schema_version 1.2.

units.description: Optional self-documenting map from payload field name to its physical unit string (#131). Added in schema_version 1.1; consumers on older schemas can safely ignore it. Keys correspond to numeric leaves present in the payload (e.g. 'failure_stress', 'knockdown', 'Vp', 'porosity_percent'); values are human-readable unit strings (e.g. 'MPa', 'dimensionless fraction in (0, 1]', '%').

failure.description: FE-field export (FESolver.export_results): failure summary. Failure indices and load factors are dimensionless.

max_tsai_wu_index.description: Legacy alias of max_failure_index (whatever the criterion).

mode_indices.description: Per-mode failure indices at the point of max_fi; null when the result carries no breakdown. An entry is null when the criterion does not separate that mode: Tsai-Wu leaves every entry except max_fi null (schema_version 1.1 wrote the invalid token NaN there). max_fi is always a number.

mode_maxima.description: Each separate failure mode's maximum over the model (Hashin, max-stress; keys fiber_t, fiber_c, matrix_t, matrix_c, shear, delamination). The delamination entry is the stress-based initiation index at ply Gauss points; the model has no explicit delamination. null for Tsai-Wu, which does not separate modes. Added in schema_version 1.3.

knockdown_factor.description: FE stiffness knockdown, porous over pristine. null when the solve has no stiffness measure (loading='thermal').

first_ply_failure_load_factor.description: Multiplier on the load named by load_factor_basis at which the criterion first reaches 1. null when no point is stressed (the factor is infinite).

interior_max_failure_index.description: max_failure_index over the elements away from the lateral faces; null when there are none.

interior_first_ply_failure_load_factor.description: first_ply_failure_load_factor over the interior elements; null when there are none or no interior point is stressed.

stiffness.description: FE-field export: effective modulus, summed reactions and, for the fracture tests, the load-point compliance.

effective_modulus_MPa.description: Strain-energy modulus in MPa (E_x or G_xy). null when there is no single modulus (ILSS bend, loading='thermal').

load_point_compliance_mm_per_N.description: Load-point compliance (mm/N) of the fracture tests (loading 'dcb', 'enf', 'mmb'): the work-conjugate displacement of the applied load over the load. Written only for those loadings.

thermal.description: FE-field export of a thermal or combined solve (FESolver.solve(delta_T=...)), added in schema_version 1.2: delta_T_K (K), alpha_local_per_K (lamina CTEs, 1/K), load_factor_basis, residual_max_failure_index and interior_max_failure_index (dimensionless), and min/max/mean/std of the ply-local residual stress (MPa).

interior_max_failure_index.description: null when no element lies away from the lateral faces.

fracture.description: FE-field export of a mesh with an explicit delamination (a delaminated interface node pair), added in schema_version 1.3: crack-face contact (crack_contact, and contact_iterations, contact_pairs, contact_converged, null when contact was off), the critical load factor of the Benzeggagh-Kenane criterion (fracture_load_factor, dimensionless, multiplying the load named by load_factor_basis; null without toughness data or when infinite) with its governing_node (original node id), governing_psi (mode mixity) and governing_G_T_N_per_mm, the porosity-toughness law that knocked the toughness down at each front node (toughness_knockdown, a description; toughness_uncalibrated, true when its uncalibrated placeholder coefficients lowered a toughness; both null without toughness data), and the virtual-crack-closure table of the front (front, null without a front). Energy release rates and toughness in N/mm (1 N/mm = 1 kJ/m^2), lengths in mm. Every undefined or non-finite value is null.

front.description: Front table, one entry per front node in every array: node and interface (integers), x_mm, y_mm, z_mm, direction_x and direction_y (growth direction), delta_a_mm, width_mm (tributary width), G_I_N_per_mm, G_II_N_per_mm, G_III_N_per_mm, G_T_N_per_mm, psi (mode mixity, null where G_T = 0), Vp (porosity at the crack plane, fraction), G_c_N_per_mm (knocked down by that porosity) and lambda_c (null columns without toughness data; a null entry where lambda_c is infinite).

delamination_onset.description: Optional FE-field export block (FESolver.export_results(..., onset=...)), added in schema_version 1.3: DelaminationOnset.summary() of the stress-based interface onset (Brewer-Lagace or Ye) of the results. criterion; x_avg_mm, the side of the in-plane averaging window (mm; 0 = nodal traction); Zc_MPa, the compressive strength of the optional compression term (null without one); load_factor_basis; max_index and interior_max_index (dimensionless, 1 = onset; null when no node was evaluated); critical_interface and critical_x_mm, critical_y_mm, critical_z_mm (null when no node was evaluated); onset_load_factor and interior_onset_load_factor (dimensionless multiples of the load named by load_factor_basis; null when infinite or not evaluated); interface_max_index, the largest index of each interface keyed by the interface as a string (null where none of its nodes was evaluated). Written only when the onset is passed.

knockdown_decomposition.description: Optional FE-field export block (FESolver.export_results(..., knockdown_decomposition=...)), added in schema_version 1.3: the FE stiffness knockdown of a porous, delaminated laminate split by defect (KnockdownDecomposition.summary()), each against the laminate with no porosity, voids or delamination. loading; knockdown_total (porosity and delamination), knockdown_porosity_only (the same porosity, every interface pair bonded), knockdown_delamination_only (the same delamination, no porosity), dimensionless; dominant, the defect whose knockdown alone is the lower (null when they agree to 1e-9). Written only when passed.

raw_sidecar.description: Basename of the optional .npz sidecar containing the raw displacement/stress/strain arrays (FESolver.export_results include_raw=True).

knockdown.description: Strength retained as a fraction of pristine (0 = failed, 1 = pristine). Dimensionless.

measured_Vp_percent.description: Measured void volume fraction in percent (%).

governing_knockdown.description: Worst-case (lowest) strength retained as a fraction of pristine. Dimensionless.
